books.title: The Red Ball
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Sam has a red ball. It is big and round.
Sam kicks the ball. The ball rolls down the hill.
The ball rolls to a big tree. A dog sits by the tree.
The dog picks up the ball. Sam runs to the dog.
Sam and the dog play with the red ball all day.

books.title: Sam and the Cat
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Sam sees a small cat. The cat is black and white.
The cat says, 'Mew, mew.' Sam smiles at the cat.
Sam gives the cat some milk. The cat drinks it all up.
The cat jumps on Sam's lap. It purrs and purrs.
Now the cat lives with Sam. They are best friends.

books.title: My Little Dog
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: I have a little dog. His name is Rex.
Rex likes to run. He runs fast in the park.
Rex sees a stick. He picks it up in his mouth.
I throw the stick. Rex runs and brings it back.
Rex is my best friend. I love my little dog.

books.title: The Little Pig
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A little pig lives on a farm. His name is Pip.
Pip likes mud. He jumps in the mud all day.
One day, Pip sees a big red apple. It is on a tree.
Pip jumps up, up, up. He gets the apple!
Pip eats the apple. Yum, yum! Pip is happy.
